_comment: Known speakers per group, used to turn diarization letters (A/B/C) into names. 'label' is the exact name to pass to `diarize.py --relabel --names`. 'aliases' are the ways Whisper spells or the speakers themselves refer to the person (nicknames, misspellings); a turn that ADDRESSES an alias identifies the OTHER speaker, a self-introduction identifies the speaker. Guests not listed here get their first name from the episode title. Add new aliases whenever a naming pass finds one.

speakers.label: Alexander
speakers.notes: Introduces himself as 'Mit navn er Alexander' or 'jeg hedder Alexander …, direktøren her i …'. Channel videos are solo pieces to camera.

speakers.label: Halfdan
speakers.notes: Usually opens the episode ('Hej og velkommen til … MarketingPod'), runs Obsidian, very active on X. Calls Kristian 'Tinho' and teases him as a 'TikTok-boy'. Beware: 'halvdelen' (= 'half of them') is ordinary Danish, not a Halfdan cue.

speakers.label: Kristian
speakers.notes: Mostly addressed by surname ('Tinho', which Whisper renders Tini/Tinju/Tino). Labelled 'Christian' in files before 2026-09-20. Came to Obsidian later than Halfdan (asks 'siden I startede Obsidian'). From Aarhus, AGF fan.

speakers.label: Niklas
speakers.notes: Bindingsperiode/marketing-bureau contract episodes and their clips.

speakers.label: Kasper
speakers.notes: Surname contains 'Christian' — don't mistake it for a Kristian cue.
